selection_rule: Prioritize foundations that increase causal depth, long-duration integrity, and principled autonomy before visual spectacle.

items.title: Compartment fluid and atmosphere network
items.proposal: Replace the lumped cabin model with room-level gas, pressure, ventilation and isolation nodes.
items.potential: Leaks, smoke and contamination become spatial rather than global.
items.primary_risk_boundary: Keep human-health interpretation bounded and validate conservation.

items.title: Full navigation covariance and geometry
items.proposal: Add covariance matrices, relative-motion geometry and optional SPICE adapters.
items.potential: Encounters and rendezvous gain realistic uncertainty ellipsoids and closing geometry.
items.primary_risk_boundary: Do not imply precision unsupported by ephemeris or sensor data.

items.title: Procedure and checklist engine
items.proposal: Bind alerts and failure modes to versioned, role-authorized procedures with hold points.
items.potential: Crew can train, execute and review realistic procedures.
items.primary_risk_boundary: Procedures must not invent a successful repair or bypass command authority.

items.title: Damage topology and repair graph
items.proposal: Represent components, lines, buses, zones, access paths, spares and repair dependencies.
items.potential: Damage produces local consequences and meaningful repair expeditions.
items.primary_risk_boundary: Avoid fake component specificity until source-pinned or clearly assumed.

items.title: Effects-first tactical encounter geometry
items.proposal: Model detection, relative geometry, maneuver, occlusion, power, heat, communications and damage propagation.
items.potential: Supports tense conflict, rescue and avoidance without arbitrary hit points.
items.primary_risk_boundary: No real-world weapon-construction instructions; intent remains evidence-bounded.

items.title: Multi-ship and docking registry
items.proposal: Add independent ship archetypes, compatible interfaces, transfer manifests and shared events.
items.potential: Allows fleets, visitors, rescue craft and radically different starting ships.
items.primary_risk_boundary: Each ship keeps independent authority, resources and history.

items.title: Crew procedure learning and cross-training
items.proposal: Turn competency evidence into scheduled simulations, supervised tasks and cross-role qualification.
items.potential: Crew evolution becomes visible through actual work rather than XP.
items.primary_risk_boundary: Learning pressure never automatically promotes skill.

items.title: Long-duration soak and corruption laboratory
items.proposal: Run millions of deterministic turns, randomized save/reload, partial-write and corruption tests.
items.potential: Proves whether the world survives long campaigns and interrupted local operation.
items.primary_risk_boundary: Store reproducible failure seeds and do not hide flaky cases.

items.title: Instrument plugin library
items.proposal: Register real and hypothetical-bounded instruments with calibration, noise and observation channels.
items.potential: Planets and anomalies can be studied through distinct factual tools.
items.primary_risk_boundary: Instrument capability must be source-pinned or assumption-labelled.

items.title: Holodeck and renderer adapter contract
items.proposal: Allow 2D, 2.5D, 3D and cinematic renderers to consume immutable room, ship and event semantics.
items.potential: Graphics can improve dramatically without rewriting expedition history.

items.title: Coexisting Village shared inhabitant kernel
items.proposal: Port rooted option eligibility, role authority, provenance, learning evidence and append-only relationships into the village.
items.potential: Tests the same principled autonomy in a social and economic world.
items.primary_risk_boundary: Avoid reducing inhabitants to utility optimizers or hidden morality scores.

items.title: Local authoritative multiplayer host
items.proposal: Synchronize human and machine participants through deterministic intent packets and signed state updates.
items.potential: Friends can join expeditions without giving clients world authority.
items.primary_risk_boundary: Offline single-player remains complete; networking is optional.

items.title: Scientific source refresh pipeline
items.proposal: Import reviewed official catalog snapshots while preserving previous revisions and source dates.
items.potential: Factual baselines can improve without silently changing old saves.
items.primary_risk_boundary: No live source may overwrite pinned historical facts.

items.title: Private medical and wellbeing boundary
items.proposal: Separate private crew reports, task-fitness decisions and public operational consequences.
items.potential: Crew wellbeing can matter without exposing private narratives to every subsystem.
items.primary_risk_boundary: No fake mind score and no medical diagnosis without a validated model.

items.title: Autonomous crew sandbox and counterfactual rehearsal
items.proposal: Let crew test proposed actions in cloned state branches before requesting execution.
items.potential: Clever autonomy gains foresight without experimenting on canonical reality.
items.primary_risk_boundary: Counterfactual outcomes remain simulations and may not be presented as observed facts.
